priceSnapshot.note: Spot 63,613.2 against midnight's 63,534.2 - UP 79.0 points, +0.12%, in four and three quarter hours. The bounce did not just hold, it broadened: price is now above ALL FOUR 15m EMAs, ALL FOUR 1H EMAs including the 1H ema200 at 63,552.5, and it has reclaimed the 4H ema50 at 63,554.2 that midnight was sitting 16.4 points UNDER. The session since the midnight snapshot ran 63,287.8 to 63,781.6. That high is the whole story of the morning: it stopped 15.7 points short of the 4H ema100 at 63,797.3 and 37.6 points short of the daily ema20 at 63,819.2 - the wall midnight named - and price has since eased 168.4 points back to sit on the reclaimed line.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below $63,287.8 - the low of the 09:00Z bar and the low of the whole post-midnight session. The line rises 447.8 points from midnight's 62,840.0, and it rises because the structure it protects is no longer the same structure: midnight was defending a reclaim of the 1H ema20/50/100 cluster, this report is defending a reclaim of the 1H ema200 (63,552.5) AND the 4H ema50 (63,554.2), which is a timeframe higher. A settled close under 63,287.8 breaks the 15m ema100 (63,296.6) in the same move and puts price back inside the 63,300 realized-liquidation band, the heaviest single burn zone on the 21-hour map at $1,055,723.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 4H close above $63,970.0 - UNCHANGED from midnight, deliberately. Midnight nominated the 63,798-63,965 band as one wall (4H ema100 63,797.3, daily ema20 63,819.2, 4H ema200 now 64,025.2) and said half-measures inside it are noise. The morning tested the bottom edge of that wall at 63,781.6 and did not get through, so the gate has been tested once and has not been earned - moving it down now would be rewarding a failed test. The confirmation beyond price is still open interest: this leg has run on OI FALLING 1.26% since midnight and 2.69% since endday, which is shorts covering. A break of the wall that finally runs on RISING OI would be the first evidence in five sessions that a buyer, not a coverer, is doing the work.

Midnight's ADD was a correction of an invalidated defensive trim taken with price 16.4 points UNDER the 4H ema50; this ADD is taken with that ema50 reclaimed and held, the 1H ema200 reclaimed, and 4H MACD histogram at +107.65 with the line at -26.44 approaching a zero cross. The reduce line rises 447.8 points to 63,287.8 to sit under the new structure rather than the old. The add gate is left untouched at 63,970.0 because it was tested and held. This is the FRESHEST cluster on the chart - it was burned by the 11:00Z push to 63,781.6 - and it is predominantly short liquidation. It is the only meaningful burn zone above spot; between 63,800 and the top of the window there is almost nothing ($26,477 at 63,800), which is why a settled break of the 63,798-63,965 wall has little in the way of friction above it.

liquidityMagnet.note: READ THIS AS A SOURCE CHANGE, NOT ONLY A MARKET CHANGE. Midnight set pull DOWN from the CoinGlass Model-3 heatmap, which shows RESTING leverage - forward-looking fuel. This run the OKX realized feed passed the freshness guard for the first time in four sessions (newest fill 11:48:57Z at 63,758, roughly two minutes old), so the map here is BURNED leverage - backward-looking. The two measure different things and should not be compared band for band. On this feed the flow points UP: of $4,915,351 liquidated in the window, $3,018,946 was shorts against $1,896,405 longs, a 1.59-to-1 squeeze, and the newest burn is the 63,700 short cluster from the 11:00Z push. The heavy bands below at 63,300, 63,200 and 62,900 are spent fuel from the 16 August flush rather than orders waiting to be hit. The honest caveat is that a spent band below and an unresolved resting magnet below are indistinguishable on this feed - CoinGlass had 910.85K at 62,623.1 six hours ago and nothing here refutes it.

The yes marks are 13 August morning, 13 August endday, 15 August morning, 15 August endday, 16 August morning and now 17 August midnight; 12 August morning, midday and endday, 13 August midnight and midday, 14 August midnight, morning, midday and endday, 15 August midnight and midday, 16 August midday and 16 August endday are the no marks.
calibration.note: The prior report is today's 2026-08-17-midnight, published at 02:25:00-05:00 with spot at 63,534.2. Its reduce line at 62,840.0 did NOT fire and was never close - the lowest settled 1H close in the window was 63,315.7 on the 09:00Z bar, 475.7 points clear, and the window low of 63,287.8 never came within 447.8 points of the line. Its add gate at 63,970.0 did NOT fire either: the session high of 63,781.6 fell 188.4 points short, stopping 15.7 points under the 4H ema100 at 63,797.3. So midnight published a range and price stayed inside it for four and three quarter hours, which is what a 45% range probability is supposed to look like. actingHelped is TRUE. Midnight bought 18 USDT of spot at 63,534.2, roughly 0.00028331 BTC, and spot marks 79.0 points higher at 63,613.2 - about +0.022 USDT. That is a small number and it should be read as a small number: it is the sixth-smallest absolute outcome in the file and it barely clears noise. What deserves more weight than the PnL is the reasoning check. Midnight's central argument was that endday's own falsification test had resolved against endday - reclaim of the 63,090.5 gate on FALLING open interest - and that the correct response was to restore part of what endday sold rather than to chase. Open interest has now fallen a further 1.26% while price rose another 79.0 points, the long/short account ratio has broken under 2.00 for the first time in this sequence at 1.97, and the realized feed shows shorts liquidated 1.59-to-1 over longs. Every leg of midnight's thesis has strengthened rather than decayed. The second thing worth recording is the placement. Midnight sized the buy at 18 USDT rather than the 32.4 it was restoring, and explicitly named the reasons - price under the 4H ema50, daily below all four EMAs, 1H RSI 0.38 off overbought. The 4H ema50 has since been reclaimed and the 1H RSI has cooled to 62.88 while price rose, so two of those three reservations have resolved favourably without the desk having to pay for the wait. This is the first session in the file where restraint was rewarded rather than punished, and it is the counter-example to the 14-16 August pattern of arguing against a trade and taking it anyway at reduced size - here the reduced size WAS the right answer and the follow-up buy is being taken on better evidence rather than on worse.
